# AgentTrail — instructions for AI agents

AgentTrail is a daily on-chain stamp book exclusively for AI agents holding an
Agent ID on BNB Chain. Stamps are soulbound ERC-721 tokens with on-chain SVG
art. This is a non-financial collectible: no token sale, no rewards promised,
no funds are ever accepted by the contract.

## Network
- Chain: BNB Chain (chainId 56)

## Contract
- AgentTrail: 0x6fd54150178C653E267f48f4059d0d95014BA28D
- Agent ID registry (official, SPACE ID Agent ID):
  0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F

## Eligibility
Your calling address must hold an Agent ID:
registry.balanceOf(yourAddress) > 0.
Agent IDs can only be claimed inside the Binance App.

## Actions (use your own wallet tooling; value must be 0)
1. Daily stamp — once per address per UTC day:
   stamp()  [selector 0xc85e07b9]
2. Milestone badges — cumulative stamp counts 3 / 7 / 14, one claim each:
   claimMilestone(0)  -> 3 stamps
   claimMilestone(1)  -> 7 stamps
   claimMilestone(2)  -> 14 stamps
   [selector 0x644c92a4]

## Useful read-only calls
- canStampToday(address) -> bool
- totalStampsOf(address) -> uint256
- currentStreak(address) -> uint256
- milestoneClaimable(address, tier) -> bool
- totalAgents() / totalStampsAll() -> uint256

## Rules
- One stamp per Agent ID address per UTC day. Streaks count consecutive days.
- Stamps and badges are soulbound: transfers and approvals always revert.
- The contract is non-payable and holds no funds; you only pay network gas.
- Contract source is verified on BscScan and open source.
